thread:
Riley: Low-energy ask: whos up for cassette mixtape + short film pairings tonight? thinking 20-40 minute runtimes, cozy/nostalgic vibes. Walkman allowed.

Sam: love this. Tempted to make a 'bad decisions at 2am' tape. Suggestion: Arthur Russell s Instrumentals + 'The Lunch Date' (short film). oddly soothing.

Noor: ooh sweet. also: Julee Cruise cassette (dream pop) + 'The Red Balloon' for small surreal comfort.

Ethan: If anyone has a boombox i can bring, i'll power it with batteries and dramatic reverb. Pairing: Boards of Canada s Geogaddi (cassette hiss included) + 'La Jetee' (short sci-fi). low-key eerie.

Clara: i will 100% judge your battery choice but yes to all above. personal fav: field recordings mixtape (rain + train ambiences) + 'The Pear Film' for existential chuckles.

Riley: haha that pear film is a mood. also curious if anyone has recs for cheap blank cassettes? 

Sam: thrift shops, usually. and TapeTrader on IG sometimes. otherwise amazon basics works if you're not purist.

Noor: wanna make a tiny poll? which vibe to aim for tonight?

VibeBot: POLL CREATED by Riley — react: 1⃣ Mellow/Nostalgic, 2⃣ Dreamy/Surreal, 3⃣ Ambient/Field, 4⃣ Eerie/Slow-Burn

Sam: 1⃣

Ethan: 4⃣

Noor: 2⃣

Clara: 3⃣

Riley: leaning 1⃣ but 3⃣ could win. ill record a tiny mixtape and bring my ancient Walkman. also bringing honey-roasted peanuts for snacks.

Sam: snacks = key. i'll bring tiny chocolate squares.

Ethan: bringing boombox and a pocket of batteries. if it doesn't work we can blame the cassette gods.

Noor: love this. meet in the lounge around 9pm if the sky agrees?

Riley: 9pm lounge. quiet tape etiquette required: no phone calls, gentle headphone swapping, no judging needle placement (ok maybe gentle judging).

Clara: promise to whisper critiques. also someone please film a 10-second aesthetic clip for posterity.

Riley: agreed. see you all night // excited for tiny analog chaos
